For I announce your sufferings and declare the calamity that has befallen you, and I will make a lamentation like a lyre, and I will strike it thus, and I will make the song heard, like the wall that you have rebuilt. For the prophet said at the beginning of the vision, 'Moab will be destroyed at night', and 'the wall of Moab will be destroyed at night'. Interpreting the power of these words, we say that when an earthquake occurred, the wall of Moab was destroyed, and before the enemies' attack, it was almost shaken from its foundations and fell, which is what they had rebuilt, and they spent their labor in vain. For the Assyrians and Babylonians took the entire land without difficulty. My inner parts will resound, he says, over your calamities like a lyre, and I will make your suffering famous thus; just as your wall, which you rebuilt, was destroyed, but not for any useful purpose. For when the wall fell automatically, none of the things that happened in all of Moab, or in other cities and lands, were hidden. And it will be that when you are ashamed, Moab will labor in vain on the altars, and will enter the handmade things, so as to pray, but will not be able to save itself. And what is more, he says, the same thing will happen to you again, which will be a shame and a disgrace to you; for you will labor in vain, filling the altars with blood, and making the sacrifices endless, and offering prayers to the handmade things.

You will not be able to attain anything for benefit and salvation. For they will not be able to deliver you from the evils that have been imposed. For what power is in idols, lifeless things, which are also human discoveries, and have as their creators those who worship them? Therefore, as the blessed David says, let those who make them become like them, and all who trust in them. But it should be known that the Moabites have become extremely superstitious, and are bird augurs and false prophets, and tellers of portents, and have greatly dared to trust in the evils of magic. For they thought perhaps to be able to prevail against the hand of their enemies, not so much, as I think, by the experience of their tactics, but by the assistance of their gods. But they have erred in their hope, calling upon lifeless matter through sacrifices and prayer for assistance. This is the word that the Lord spoke concerning Moab, when he also spoke. This is the vision that was spoken concerning the Moabites by God, when he also spoke, that is, even if before the words came through me, and most of what he had spoken about it, and upon myriads it itself…
pass_b_english: I am declaring your sufferings and making known the calamity that has befallen you.
For the prophet said at the beginning of the vision, 'Moab will be destroyed at night', and 'the wall of Moab will be destroyed at night'. (Isaiah 15:1)

When an earthquake occurred, the wall of Moab was destroyed, and it was what the Moabites had rebuilt, and before the enemies' attack it was almost shaken from its foundations and fell, and thus they spent their labor in vain.
The Assyrians and Babylonians took the entire land without difficulty.
My inner parts will resound over your calamities like a well-tuned lyre, and I will make your suffering heard; just as your wall, which you rebuilt, was destroyed, but not for any useful purpose.
For when the wall fell automatically, none of the things that happened in all of Moab, or in other cities and lands, were hidden.
And it will be that when you are ashamed, Moab will labor in vain on the altars, and will enter the handmade things, so as to pray, but will not be able to save itself.

Furthermore, the same thing will happen to you again, which will be a shame and a disgrace to you; for you will labor in vain, filling the altars with blood, and making the sacrifices endless, and offering prayers to the handmade things, but they will not be able to deliver you from the evils that have been imposed.
For what power is in idols, lifeless things, which are also human discoveries, and have as their creators those who worship them?
Therefore, as the blessed David says, let those who make them become like them, and all who trust in them.

The Moabites had become extremely superstitious, engaging in bird augury, false prophecy, and the telling of portents, and had greatly dared to trust in the evils of magic, thinking that these practices would give them an advantage against their enemies, but they had erred in their hope, calling upon lifeless matter for assistance through sacrifices and prayer.
This is the word that the Lord spoke concerning Moab, when he also spoke.

This is the vision that was spoken concerning the Moabites by God, when he also spoke, that is, even if before the words came through me, and most of what he had spoken about it, and upon myriads it itself…
